Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Ombré Wool Rug, 5' x 8', Red
Colors: Red
Materials: wool
Pile: 100% Wool, Backing: 100% Canvas Imported Deep and light hues fade into each other in this ombré pattern rug. Subtle yet striking, this 100% wool rug is high on style and softness. Area rug features an ombré pattern Hand-tufted with 100% wool fibers Plush .65'' pile suits high-traffic indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 5' x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
